summary: time billable-confirmation first slice on BASE 61950e1. Created pmo_plugins.time as a new plugin app (manifest exactly 8 fields with requires={contracts} and empty capabilities; own migration time/0001_initial; settings INSTALLED_APPS + PMO_PLUGIN_MODULES and pmo_plugins/delivery/urls root single-write binding) whose first slice only owns BillableConfirmation (canonical x-owner=time owned_fact): organization, draft/confirmed status (reversed enum reserved but not produced), timesheet_ref (namespace=time/kind=timesheet/version), contract_line_ref (contracts), confirmed_minutes 1..1440, confirmed_on, evidence>=1, version, created_by/confirmed_by/confirmed_at, create_token/digest, plus BillableConfirmationReceipt with action draft.save/confirm. Migration 0001 installs SQLite and PostgreSQL guards: inserts only draft; draft business fields (timesheet/contract refs, minutes, date, evidence) are editable with version+1 while identity/create fields stay frozen; one draft->confirmed transition with confirmer present, creator != confirmer and the final business facts frozen; confirmed facts immutable and undeletable; receipts immutable. A draft-edit regression edits minutes/evidence, confirms, and verifies the confirmation uses the edited values. Services save_billable_confirmation_draft and confirm_billable enforce company lock, fresh role/module checks (disabled module write refusal, history read retained), read-only core.services.approved_timesheet_for_billable (approved same-org timesheet, minutes not exceeded), read-only contracts.approved_line_snapshot (single approved version, confirmed_time template, same project, as-of effective date), period/lock/future-date checks, one confirmed per timesheet+contract line, idempotent receipts with replay/changed-input conflict, and independent confirmation (creator cannot confirm). Confirmation writes exactly one canonical time.billable_confirmed.v1 (source=confirmation ref, changed_refs=[confirmation, timesheet, contract_line], posting_event_refs=[]) with a suppressed plugin.time.billable.confirmed audit source, and writes no revenue, ledger, cash or open-item fact. Browser list/form/confirm views and domain-metadata routes are wired; verify_integrity adds the time branch (status/minutes/reference existence and same org/timesheet+line state/envelope/one confirmed per pair/self-confirmation/no financial event or source consumption). Known integration dependency: because time requires contracts, three pre-existing dependency-guard tests that hard-code the dependants to disable now also need 'time', and the cash verify query-count ceiling 80 becomes 82 (needs 84); per Lead ruling these four cross-slice test edits are handled by a whitelist correction + integration sync after this PR, so the full suite currently shows the known 8 macOS baseline failures plus these 4 attributable, disclosed failures (expected to return to baseline after sync).

review.reviewer: independent PH-269 time-billable-confirmation reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER - the advertised draft-edit path is rejected by the frozen trigger: `save_billable_confirmation_draft(..., confirmation_id=...)` updates confirmed_minutes/confirmed_on/evidence/timesheet_ref/contract_line_ref and increments version, and report.deviations says '草稿可改（version+1）'. But migration time/0001's `FACT_FIELDS` includes exactly those business fields (`timesheet_ref`, `timesheet_id`, `contract_line_ref`, `contract_line_id`, `confirmed_minutes`, `confirmed_on`, `evidence`), and both PostgreSQL and SQLite update guards reject any update where any `FACT_FIELDS` value changes. Any real draft revision therefore raises 'Billable confirmation facts are immutable'; there is no draft-edit regression test (the scoped tests cover create/replay/confirm only). This repeats the PH-265 draft-edit defect and makes the service API + report claim untruthful. Fix: allow draft->draft changes to the business fields (timesheet_ref/id, contract_line_ref/id, confirmed_minutes, confirmed_on, evidence) with version+1 while keeping created_by/created_at/create_token/create_digest/identity and confirmed facts immutable, and add a draft-edit test (create -> revise -> confirm edited content); or remove the confirmation_id edit branch and update the spec/report to draft-create-only. Do not leave service support that the DB always rejects.

CORE IMPLEMENTATION OTHERWISE SOUND: time is a new plugin app with exactly the 8 manifest fields and requires={contracts}, its own time/0001 migration (no core/contracts/cash/settlement rewrites), settings.PMO_PLUGIN_MODULES/INSTALLED_APPS and delivery/urls root binding; BillableConfirmation is append-only (insert draft-only, confirmed immutable, deletes/receipt updates rejected, unique confirmed per org+timesheet_id+contract_line_id), confirmation requires draft->confirmed, creator != confirmer and period/locked/future checks; services re-read fresh owner/finance/module, validate approved Timesheet via the named core read-only helper (no copied timesheet table), validate an approved contract_line by contracts `approved_line_snapshot` with same project and confirmed_time template, enforce minutes <= approved minutes, idempotent request_token/receipts, same timesheet+line uniqueness, and exactly one canonical `time.billable_confirmed.v1` with source=confirmation ref, changed_refs=[confirmation, timesheet, contract_line], posting_event_refs=[] plus a suppressed plugin audit (no duplicate canonical topic); no revenue/ledger/cash/open-item write. Draft deletion is intentionally disallowed (disclosed deviation from the behavior sentence; model/trigger precedence is acceptable if the spec is corrected).

VERIFY/WHITELIST/PENDING SYNC: the time verify branch checks statuses/minutes/timesheet+contract-line refs/state, confirmed self-decision/event envelope/duplicate confirmed keys, draft decision fields/no event, and absence of AccountingEvent/SourceConsumption time rows; it is batch-oriented, adds no global ban and coexists with the existing branches. The cash bridge query-count +2 and the three plugin dependency-disable loop tests are the known cross-slice failures caused by adding time (requires contracts); they are not in PH-269's BASE whitelist and are correctly deferred to the PH-273 whitelist correction/rebase. I independently confirmed the full suite is exactly the 8 known macOS baseline failures plus those 4 (test_acceptance_revenue dependency guard, two test_v1_contract_change* loop tests, test_v1_cash_book_bridge query count) - no fifth failure class.
